assertions.page_context: Sign-up page for creating an Apify account
assertions.source_quote: create an account at the [sign-up page](https://console.apify.com/sign-up)

assertions.page_context: Sign-in page for existing Apify accounts
Email verification page reached from the sign-in flow
assertions.source_quote: you can click on the **Resend verification email** button to send the email again

assertions.page_context: Account settings, Login & Privacy section for managing authentication methods
assertions.source_quote: go to the [Login & Privacy](https://console.apify.com/settings/security) section of your account settings

assertions.page_context: Landing page after signing in to Apify Console
assertions.source_quote: you land on the **Dashboard** section that provides an overview of your account
**Recently viewed**: Displays Actors you have recently accessed.
**Suggested Actors for you**: Recommends Actors that might interest you
**Actor runs**: Shows your recent Actor runs, as well as scheduled runs and tasks.
